# Rhino Tire USA

> Wholesale (B2B) distributor of trailer, passenger, light-truck and commercial-truck
> tires, steel trailer wheels, tire & wheel assemblies and trailer parts.
> Legal name: RHINO TIRE USA LLC. Warehouses: Orlando, FL and Dallas, TX.
> Wholesale only — dealer pricing requires an approved account.

## Key pages

- /tires — tire catalog by category (ST trailer, passenger, light truck, commercial truck)
- /tires/st-trailer/{size} — all SKUs per trailer-tire size with live stock status
- /products/{slug} — product detail with full spec tables (load range, ply, max load/PSI)
- /knowledge — practical guides written from our own distribution data
- /quote — wholesale quote request
- /become-a-dealer — dealer account application

## Facts

- Stock status is published as buckets (In Stock / Limited / Contact) from real warehouse data.
- Pricing is tiered per dealer and never published publicly.
- Specialties: ST trailer tires (ST205/75R15, ST225/75R15, ST235/80R16), steel trailer wheels
  (6x5.5 and other common bolt patterns), commercial truck tires (11R22.5, 295/75R22.5).
